fact: The Reporter says a government and UN workshop in the week to 26 August 2026 explored development of a national AI strategy, building on the validation of a Draft Artificial Intelligence Policy, with no adoption date given for the draft.

Tech Africa News reports that Lesotho's ICT ministry (MICSTI) with the UN began work on a National AI Strategy at a five-day workshop in Maseru, 17 to 21 August 2026; the strategy is described as expected, not adopted.

The UN Resident Coordinator, opening a workshop on the National AI Strategy on 17 August 2026, acknowledged the government's draft Artificial Intelligence Policy and said Lesotho was beginning a national conversation on AI.
Lesotho's Deputy Prime Minister, speaking for the government at the UN Global Dialogue on AI Governance, referred to the country's 'Artificial Intelligence Policy of 2025' as its standing AI policy.
